decision.hypothesis: The next uncertainty is physical: whether the exact saved midpoint-input schedule can make the collision-faithful repaired candidate achieve native probe-button contact, sustained force/depth regulation, and clean release while satisfying all actuator and collision constraints. H1 predicts complete task acceptance. The competing H0 predicts failure from contact timing or force dynamics, lateral misalignment, unexpected collision, actuator limits, or release transients. T09-210 records generation of the collision-faithful hardware; T09-211 binds candidate 52fbff225dd926fb7d2bc7f3bba7d89a18a90047adaece3471f750970141caf9 and states execution_started=false; T09-212 records source 4b3a05471f6cb25955fbe4b06dc29409d24992ec8f3d37ceb12e0cb58422f0b5 with task_acceptance=unmeasured. Thus physical performance remains UNKNOWN.
decision.expected_observation: One fresh complete native replay exhibits qualifying probe-button contact during 0.35-0.60 s; at least 0.4 s continuous hold within 0.90-1.40 s with button depth 0.00175-0.00225 m and normal force 0.08-0.12 N; lateral x-z error at most 0.002 m; button travel at most 0.003 m with negative travel no more than 1e-6 m; tensions within 0.2-8 N, tendon stroke within -0.015 to 0.015 m, tendon speed at most 0.025 m/s; no unexpected penetrating contact; valid contact-force and button mass-balance cross-checks; and, at both 1.8 and 2.0 s, residual travel at most 0.0001 m, normal force at most 0.01 N, and probe speed at most 0.01 m/s, with every other frozen hard check passing.
decision.weakening_observation: Any complete-replay hard-check failure refutes H1 for this exact candidate-schedule pair, including absent or late qualifying contact, interrupted hold, out-of-range hold depth or force, excessive lateral error, unexpected collision, tension/stroke/speed violation, button overtravel or negative travel, failed force cross-check, numerical failure, or excessive residual travel, contact force, or probe speed at either release time.
decision.fixed_conditions: Keep the T09 default condition, task definition, acceptance thresholds, zero robot and button initial state, 0.20 N initial tension, seed 17, gravity, geometry and environment extension, contact and collision settings, 0.001 s physics timestep, 0.01 s control and sample periods, 2.0 s duration, required signals, candidate 52fbff225dd926fb7d2bc7f3bba7d89a18a90047adaece3471f750970141caf9, and exact source schedule 4b3a05471f6cb25955fbe4b06dc29409d24992ec8f3d37ceb12e0cb58422f0b5 fixed. Do not reoptimize control, modify design, or alter any window or threshold.
decision.stopping_condition: Stop after one complete independent native replay and retain its full result. Select only if every frozen hard check passes; otherwise stop this test and use the recorded failure mode in a separate diagnosis.
decision.interpretation: A complete pass supplies independent physical-replay evidence for acceptance of only this exact candidate-schedule pair under the single frozen default condition; it does not establish broader robustness. A failure establishes that this schedule is not acceptable on this candidate and identifies whether contact/hold/release physics or a frozen constraint caused the failure, but does not prove that no other controller could make the hardware succeed.
